lines.text: Jesus sat in a boat by the sea while the crowds stood on the shore and He taught in parables.
Some seed fell along the path and was devoured by birds, some on rocky ground, and some among thorns.
The seed on rocky ground sprang up quickly, but the sun scorched it and it withered for lack of water.
The disciples asked why Jesus spoke in parables, and He said the prophecy of Jeremiah was fulfilled in the people.
The evil one snatches the seed on the path, and the seed on good soil is the one who understands.
